sentences.text: [1] The appeal is taken up for Settlement in Lok Adalat.
[2] Mr. L.R. Dabhi, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal/settlement pursis, which is taken on record.
The withdrawal/settlement pursis is signed by the authorized signatory, which is presented in person in the Court, and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP.

[3] It is submitted that the offeence alleged against the accused persons under the Prevention of Food Adulteration HC-NIC Page 1 of 2 Created On Sat Sep 16 11:54:00 IST 2017 R/CR.A/1354/2014 ORDER Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty/punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, it is State Of Gujarat - Thro' Bharatkumar ... vs Yusufbhai Yakubbhai Patel & ... on 9 September, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113105904/
1 compoundable under Section 69 of the Act.
[4] In view of the withdrawal/settlement pursis, the present appeal stands disposed of.
[5] The Record and Proceedings (R & P) is ordered to be remitted to the Trial Court forthwith.
